segments.title: 2 checks before you connect
bullets: How do I remove its access?
segments.say: Before you connect your email, check: can you export your data, and remove its access?

segments.title: Clean up old access
segments.say: Your Google or Microsoft account settings list apps with access. Remove ones you don't use.
